rejected.reason: The grouping combines disparate and distant passages: n-36-6 concerns the radical founding method of the ideal state in Book VII by exiling everyone over ten years old, while n-40-2 concerns a mathematical calculation in Book IX of the numerical ratio comparing the pleasure of a king to that of a tyrant. Grouping these two isolated occurrences as an overarching topic of regime realization and tyranny creates an incoherent pair that lacks common subject continuity.
